author: BoldAndBrash
body:
I believe it'd be nice to have a "vote" during the handpicking of staff. Let's say we got 10 people who we thought would be nice mods. The community could vote maximum 5 people from that batch who they think would be a nice addition. Of course, there would be people who troll during the votes. To get past this, we could have it so the person must say at least 2 reasons why that handpicked person should become a junior mod.

Obviously, if most of the staff disagree with an opinion, they can investigate further or ignore it.

I made this topic because I've noticed a few players talking about how they wish they could have a say in who would become a part of the Staff team.

title: A New Way Of Handpicking?

replies.author: Atdit
replies.body:
+0.5

1. Not with votes, people with many alts (hehe) could abuse it!

2. 1/2 players of the current staff didn't I notice before they became a staff member, plus, more active players which are better-known will have an advantage, with our normal Apply-system has everyone a fair chance and nobody an advantage to become a staff member.

3. +1 for the idea to handpick them.

replies.body: Unfortunately, we aren't going to be involving the community in handpicking staff members. We've already worked out a system that we think will work out quite smoothly. I won't be releasing any information on it, but you'll know when it happens.

replies.body: I don't understand why people are saying that hand-picked staff would be a bias thing.  If you think about it, any type of staff application process can be biased.  You would accept someone else application and not a more suitable one.  You can't escape bias.  It is just out there.
